interpretation: association conditional on observed pairs; unmeasured confounding not ruled out; no identified do(T) effect
unit: log10 per CSV raw temperature unit

cohort_comparison_note: Compare within slope to pooled_same_subset to hold observations fixed; pooled_slope uses all development records
permutation_assumption: temperature exchangeability within exact pairs; unverified with missing experimental-source metadata
sensitivity_scope: point-estimate omitted-variable bias identity; not cluster-adjusted confidence interval or evidence that confounding exists
